_meta.description: Machine-readable map of the SYX ecosystem: layers, precedence, who generates what, who guards what, and how modes compose. Written for any AI agent, not one in particular. The human-readable twin, with the same graph as Mermaid diagrams, is _agents/architecture.md.
_meta.rule: This file DESCRIBES; it never authorises. Every entry carries a `source`: the file it is derived from. When this map and its source disagree, the source wins and this map is what needs fixing.
_meta.antiDrift: No mutable inventory is duplicated here. Counts, paths and per-item detail stay in the machine-readable file that already owns them (`countSource` / `see` fields point there). This file only encodes what otherwise exists in prose alone.
_meta.maintainedBy: tier auto (contracts/trust.json: `_agents/`) — update it in the same change that alters the shape it describes

layers.name: The law
layers.role: What may be written (trust tiers) and what code must look like (R01-R08). Nothing outranks them.
layers.writable: human-only, on purpose: the judged do not edit the judge

layers.name: The engine
layers.role: What a mode does, in what format, under which permission ceiling. Modes (Trust + Knowledge blocks), workflows, prompts, decision-record, this map.

layers.name: The cortex
layers.role: Why a decision is right: governance (ATLAS composition), atlas-rules (guest editorial domain), knowledges (the corpus), routing (derived wiring), constitution. Informs; never executes, never authorises.
layers.writable: auto today via the `*.md` pattern; ACOPLE.md proposes human for governance/, atlas-rules/, constitution.md and README.md — pending decision
layers.note: Shipped docs reference these paths; an npm consumer does not have them. Known, intentional, unguarded.

layers.name: The source
layers.role: 4-tier token system (primitives -> semantic -> component), atoms, molecules, organisms, utilities, layout, pages, themes.
layers.writable: mixed: components/utilities/component-tokens are pr (via propose.js); primitives, semantic, mixins, themes, base are human-only

layers.name: Derived artifacts
layers.role: Everything generated from the source or from the modes. Never edited by hand except the prose fields the generators preserve (registry `description`/`usage`).

layers.name: The guards
layers.role: Validators and generators. `npm run check` chains them all.
layers.writable: human-only: a guard the agent can rewrite guards nothing

layers.name: The query surface
layers.role: Ask the system instead of reading it. MCP server (stdio) and the Node API answer from the same layer (consulta.js), so agent and application get the same answer.

precedence.description: When two documents disagree, the higher rung wins - no exceptions by context.

rungs.decides: how ATLAS and the modes compose

trustTiers.description: Three write tiers. The boundary follows the cascade: the higher a file sits, the more places a change reaches, the less an agent decides alone. Unmatched paths default to human.
tiers: pr (propose.js: branch + evidence, a person merges)
trustTiers.paths: see contracts/trust.json tiers.*.paths - not duplicated here
trustTiers.resolver: scripts/lib/confianza.js clasificarRuta(): longest matching pattern wins; `*.md` matches markdown at any depth

modes.description: Nine lenses over a task, activated by the `[SYX: MODE]:` prefix or `/syx`. A mode grants no permission: its Trust block is checked against trust.json by check:modos. Tier = cost of interrogating the system, not of loading the cortex - two separate axes.

grammar.pipeline: A -> B : each output feeds the next
grammar.evaluative: A + B : both modes work the same artifact
grammar.grouping: + binds before ->, so UX -> UI + AUDIT reads UX -> (UI + AUDIT)
grammar.atlasWrapper: [ATLAS]: wraps a mode and decides what/why at rung 5 authority; it is not a mode itself

modes.knowledgeWiring: each mode's Knowledge block is the source; mind-system/routing.md is the derived two-way view

inventory.description: Counts live in the generated files, not here.

queries.nodeApi: require('syx-design-system') - the same queries plus path helpers and listTokens (deliberately not an MCP tool)

edges.via: npm run export:figma (scripts/lib/figma.js does every unit/colour conversion)
scripts/lib/rules.js -> syx-validate.js (R01-R07) and validate_snippet; R08 declared, not yet implemented
npm run check:modos (also keeps CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and _agents/modes/README.md listing the same modes)
hand-maintained today; guard B (check-conocimiento.js) specified in ACOPLE.md, not built
routing labels: Always / When relevant / With GSAP / On request / Self-check - none of them authorises anything

guards.description: npm run check chains them; prepublishOnly adds check:consumible. Source: package.json scripts.

map.guards: R01-R04 errors + R05-R07 warnings over scss and tokens.json
theme symmetry across the seven themes
tokens.json snapshot in sync with source
component-registry.json in sync with compiled CSS
MCP server answers like a client would see
mixin docs point at real code
mode Trust blocks vs trust.json, and the three mode indices

unguarded: mode Knowledge blocks vs routing.md (guard B pending, see ACOPLE.md)
self-containment of the npm package against mind-system/ references
